children: IES Holdings entered into an amendment to its credit agreement to expand total borrowing capacity to $700 million, comprising a $200 million term loan and a $500 million revolving credit facility. The amendment, led by Wells Fargo Bank as administrative agent with a syndicate of lenders, also adds recently acquired subsidiaries as guarantors. The company used borrowings under the facility alongside cash on hand to help fund its DBM Global acquisition, and expects the expanded capacity to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility.
